option.counterfactual: Every normalized 2-quasitrace on any unital C*-algebra sends the successive differences of a bounded increasing positive sequence to zero, regardless of whether that sequence has a least upper bound.
option.approach: Investigate whether matrix amplification and the defining 2-quasitrace identity force the quasitraces of terms in a bounded positive series to tend to zero. Apply that result to the series of successive differences.
